title: SkillFrontmatterSchema
description: Google Antigravity Skill YAML frontmatter schema (.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md) per Section 4.2 specification.

name.description: Unique identifier matching directory name (lowercase, hyphens). Defaults to folder name if omitted.

description.description: Explains what the skill does and explicit trigger scenarios used by the agent for dynamic loading (Required).

metadata.description: Optional arbitrary metadata object (e.g. category, version, author).

disable-slash-command.description: Hides the skill from the '/' interactive menu while leaving it discoverable and invocable by the model (added in v1.1.12).
